versions.changelog:
- README.md added to provide more comprehensive documentation.
- Obsolete skill-card.md file removed for clarity and maintenance.
- No changes to user-facing functionality or skill behavior.

Initial release of the h3-video-editing-prompt skill.

- Enables writing structured prompts for MiniMax H3 Ref2VA video edits, especially for masked or false-colour person/face/object replacement and cross-shot identity handling.
- Clarifies precise ownership of performance, appearance, motion, and timing between source video, mask, reference image, and audio.
- Provides comprehensive workflow guidance for inspecting assets, assigning ownership, and handling overlays and complex editing targets.
- Enforces specific output format and Ref2VA labeling for consistency and clarity.
- Includes detailed instructions for handling translucent/opaque masks, false-colour overlays, and shot transitions.
- Establishes output contract and constraints to ensure high-quality, unambiguous prompt generation.
